sloka: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन ।चारित्रसुखशीलत्वात् प्रविष्टा ऽसि मनो मम ।। ६.४८.३० ।।।।
transliteration: anṛtaṁ noktapūrvaṁ me na ca vakṣye kadācana ।cāritrasukhaśīlatvāt praviṣṭā 'si mano mama ।। 6.48.30 ।।।।

translations.english: "These two are not capable of being won in war even by gods or demons. On observation of the indications by me I am making you realize."
